# DEME Housepainting

> Family-run interior and exterior house painting business, run by a father-son team. Based in Ireland.

DEME Housepainting provides interior and exterior house painting services, from single-room jobs to full exterior repaints.

## Pages

- [Home](https://deme-housepainting.vercel.app/): Overview and quote request
- [About Us](https://deme-housepainting.vercel.app/#about): Who runs the business
- [Gallery](https://deme-housepainting.vercel.app/#gallery): Before and after photos of completed work
- [Contact](https://deme-housepainting.vercel.app/#contact): Contact form for quotes and enquiries
